headline: Converted discovery call signals into 3 production-ready pilot SOWs + execution playbook; targeted 4 prospects (Vanta, Linear, Census, Hex) with $4.8K–$24K pricing tiers.

4 Customized SOWs: Ready for founder signature (Vanta Growth $24K, Linear Professional $12K + Scale-Up, Census Professional $12K + CEO brief, Hex Entry $4.8K)
Execution Playbook: 5-phase step-by-step guide from SOW customization → founder signature → warm outreach → pilot launch → Growth conversion
Warm-Path Hooks: Customized cover letters & CEO briefings for each prospect based on discovery call context
ROI Cases: Prospect-specific financial models (Vanta $48K→$24K savings, Linear $63K→$51K savings, Census/Hex adapted)
Risk Mitigations: Documented blockers (finance gatekeeping, CEO approval, budget constraints) with specific remediation strategies
Success Metrics: Target 75% SOW signature rate (3+ of 4); 50%+ pilot-to-Growth conversion; $24K–$36K ARR expected from cohort
Timeline: 7-day execution window from Phase 1 (today) through Phase 4 (outreach launch); 45-day total cycle to Growth contracts
